_comment: HAND-TRANSCRIBED from data/docs/02_price_list_payment_plan.md (and areas from the brochure).
Nothing in this file is produced by an LLM, and no arithmetic is done by an LLM:

Every number carries the document + section it came from so the salesperson can check it.

premiums._rule: Applied on top of base price. The document states premiums are cumulative and gives the worked example: Margalla-facing corner on floor 15 = +4% +3% +6% = +13% over base. So they ADD as percentages of base; they do not compound.

_source.document: MGC Aurora Heights — Price List & Payment Plan

discounts._rule: All discount percentages are 'on base price'. The document says explicitly for full cash: 'Location premiums are not discounted.' We apply that rule to every discount, so the discount amount is always pct x BASE price, never pct x (base + premiums). The overseas 2% is described as 'additional ... stackable with the above', so percentages add (12+2 or 6+2); they do not compound.
